Sharh (description)
Exception
Exception
Exception - this is the conclusion of something from the general rule, from what was before
For example:
«All students succeeded except for one.» ( واحداً excluded word)
It is clear from the sentence that all students succeeded except for one
Exception has three pillars
«Successful students except Hamid»
1-Excluded word ( حامِـداً )
2-What makes an exception ( الطلابُ )
3-Exclusion Tool ( إلا )
There are many words with which the exclusion is carried out, the most important are the following
1st and most common is ( إلا ) and it is a particle
2nd is two words ( غَيرُ وَسِوَى ) and they are both names (nouns)
3rd is two verbs ( مَا خَلا ومَاعَدا ):
Exclusion types
An exception can be either merged (connected) or separate (cut off)
Merged exception — this, then the excluded word, which is part of what was mentioned before it
For example:
«Successful students except Hamid»
Hamid refers to students (confluent)
Separate exclusion: this is the excluded word that is not part of what was mentioned before it.
«There is a cure for every disease except death.»
Death does not apply to drugs (separate exception)
